mustHaves.value: Senior or Staff, production web apps
mustHaves.quote: the last four at Senior level on a React and TypeScript application for structural engineers
Integrated an LLM assistant that drafts calculation notes
handled streaming responses, tool calls and partial results in the UI
Built the retry and rate-limit layer for three third-party APIs
Traced production incidents from browser to Postgres logs in Grafana
Rebuilt the account dashboard's state management and component architecture
the Python services that run the solvers
Uses Claude and Cursor daily for refactors, test scaffolding and code review
ran the fortnightly demo for the engineering and ML teams

mustHaves.value: At ease in an evolving codebase
mustHaves.quote: I like joining a product while it is still being shaped
